modalLead: Tagging a whole batch of bookmarks at once is now a one-liner from the config bulk toolbar.

items.text: Bulk tags — select several bookmarks in Config → Bookmarks and the bulk toolbar now has a Tags control. Type one or more comma-separated tags, choose Add, Replace, or Remove, and apply them to every selected bookmark in one go. The field suggests tags you already use as you type.
Smoother dialogs — dialog windows now hand focus back cleanly when they close, so keyboard and screen-reader navigation stays tidy and the browser console no longer warns about it.
